description: This file defines the LongIPC class, which implements object-based inter-process communication (IPC) for handling Long (primitive) values. It provides methods for serialization to and from JSON format, including constructors, getter, and setter methods.

classes.name: LongIPC
classes.description: Implements ObjectIPC interface for handling Long values in IPC, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: LongIPC(long val)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Long value.

methods.name: setValue(long amt)
methods.description: Sets the Long value to the specified amount.

methods.name: toJSON()
methods.description: Serializes the Long value into a JSONObject.

methods.name: fromJSON(JSONObject buffer)
methods.description: Deserializes a Long value from a JSONObject.
